excerpt: The code SPM evaluation applies an ILP to 73 real-life benchmarks. For g721_encode, a 10% program SPM yields 71% of original WCET and a fully fitting SPM yields 52.2%. Across all benchmarks, tiny SPMs reach 92.6% of no-SPM WCET and full-fit SPMs reach 60%, with average code-size growth of 0.02%.
overview: This evidence quantifies the effect of allocating code to fast scratchpad memory. It supports the claim that WCET-aware memory placement can produce large reductions while keeping code growth and ILP solving overhead negligible for the evaluated benchmark set.
title: Program SPM Results
